dataset.type: Fresh authored semantic transfer challenge; not external holdout or real-user qualification ground truth

metricDefinitions.primary: Binary relevant iff authored professional relevance>=2 and authored eligibility=pass. P@5, Recall@5, binary nDCG@5 and full-pool MRR use this label.
metricDefinitions.gradedNdcgAtFive: Linear graded gains 0–3, with unknown/fail eligibility set to zero; ideal order is computed over the same pool.
metricDefinitions.textOnlyPrecisionAtFive: Professional relevance>=2 without eligibility; separate diagnostic, not the primary ranking metric.
metricDefinitions.precisionAtFiveCeiling: Maximum possible P@5 in each pool given its relevant eligible count; fewer than five positives lowers the ceiling.
metricDefinitions.fractionOfAvailableTopFiveRelevant: Hits in top five divided by min(5,relevant eligible count). This is not market accuracy.
metricDefinitions.ties: Expected binary P@5 under random ID order within identical actual non-ID sorting signals.
metricDefinitions.averaging: Macro average over the 8 needs. Baselines have the same complete professional text/technologies; filtered baselines use product eligibility, never authored truth.

limitations: Authored labels are independent of the scoring formula but are not human participant/external expert ground truth. Ambiguous labels must be identified in the independent review.
This deliberately challenging authored sample is not a prevalence estimate of real market profiles, a training target, a 90-point objective, or a new external holdout.
Five returned profiles can include non-relevant people when fewer than five relevant eligible people exist. Ceiling and Recall@5 prevent hiding that denominator.
Live employer need-to-selection and end-to-end testing with jury/users remain separate criterion 6.1 evidence.
The earlier 120-pair stress diagnostic was used as development evidence. This distinct 96-pair challenge was frozen before its first evaluation and is not a new market/user dataset.

The fresh challenge uses explicit mandatory facts and separately authored professional labels. Its six-year experience field denotes general professional experience, not an inferred commercial history for a particular language.

Matching changes must be selected without reading this challenge and committed before this evaluation. This report is not a training target, a jury score, or evidence of market-wide matching accuracy.

freeze.protocol: Dataset freeze before evaluation. Matching agent must freeze candidate before reading texts/labels. Challenge is not used to select a fix. Single final evaluation with baseline and identical mandatory filters.

snapshot.selection: Two bounded variants evaluated only on TalentMatch development and previously known stress diagnostic; A selected before fresh challenge evaluation.
limits: No fresh challenge results were used to tune implementation, weights or labels.
TalentMatch holdout has been seen historically; its final reproduction is not a new blind experiment.
